rows.grounds: measure divided into two parts; accusative of extent or predicate measure
measure pertaining to the neck; compound of gala and māna
neck having the measure of one part; fused compound with ablative/adverbial suffix -tas indicating extent

items.question: What proportional measures define the neck segment relative to its parts in this ritual configuration?
premises: The neck-measure is specified as two-part.
The neck itself is measured as one part in extent.
The particle tu marks a further specification within the prescribed proportions.
items.inference: The prescribed configuration assigns a two-part measure to the neck segment while defining the neck’s extent as one part.
uncertainties: The exact syntactic relation between dvibhāgaṃ galamānaṃ and galamekāṃśamānataḥ is ambiguous without broader ritual context.
Whether galamānaṃ refers to a physical neck dimension or a technical ritual unit is not fully determined.
items.plain_english: The neck-measure is two-part, but the neck itself is one part in measure.
